title: SPARC adaptive model composition guides an oxygen-evolution catalyst campaign
summary: SPARC combines competing regression model families through out-of-fold predictions and sparse posterior composition, using predictive dispersion to set trust for exploration. Across eight published materials datasets it achieved higher R-squared than literature-reported values in six, with gains of up to 77%. In an automated alkaline oxygen-evolution campaign, 8 of 11 SPARC-selected experiments reached overpotentials below 300 mV (best 242 mV) versus 18 of 125 initial experiments. Measurements prioritized for verification deviated by 76 mV on average versus 27 mV for matched controls. Preprint; one catalyst campaign.
